clips.title: The story
paras: Farthing serves the faithful from Stormwind's Cathedral of Light. The kind and wise human clergyman guides parishioners and directs aid to settlements across the kingdom.

Bishop Farthing tends to the spiritual needs of Stormwind City from the Cathedral of Light. Alongside Archbishop Benedictus and the gathered clergy, he counsels travelers, assists those pursuing the holy arts, and attends to the Church of the Holy Light's civic and pastoral duties.

From the capital, Farthing directs earnest travelers toward parts of the kingdom in need of holy aid. Reports tell of the necromancer Morbent Fel and an undead blight spreading through Duskwood. Farthing advises on ways to overcome dark sorceries and cleanse the blighted frontier.
